# helping-js

> Zero-dependency JavaScript utility library published on npm as `helping-js`.

## Documentation
- Site: https://helping-js.netlify.app
- Usage & install: https://helping-js.netlify.app/usage/
- Helper modules (v3): https://helping-js.netlify.app/helpers/
- Types: https://helping-js.netlify.app/types/
- Form validation: https://helping-js.netlify.app/form-validation/

## Source
- GitHub: https://github.com/parsajiravand/helping-js
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/helping-js

## What it provides
- Type checkers: `helping-js/core/types`
- Regex patterns: `helping-js/core/regex` (and phone/currency presets)
- `validate(obj, rules)`: `helping-js/core/validate`
- Optional v3 helpers: `core/number`, `core/string`, `core/array`, `core/object`, `core/async`, `core/url`, `core/date`, `core/advanced`, `core/tree`, `core/dom` (browser)
- TypeScript declarations ship with the package
